concurrency_token_choice: Explicit int Version column with .IsConcurrencyToken(). OrderService (WI-07) must increment Version before saving. xmin was not chosen because the WI assignment lists Version as a named field in the entity, meaning an explicit column is the literal reading.
jsonb_mapping_choice: System.Text.Json.JsonDocument? with .HasColumnType("jsonb") on OrderEvent.Payload, Zone.Polygon, and AuditLog.Diff. Simplest approach requiring no extra NuGet packages; callers must dispose JsonDocument instances.
deviations: Entity classes are public (not internal) because EF tests in the test project instantiate them directly via object initializers. ef-core.md examples also use public class.

No navigation properties on any entity — all FK constraints use .HasOne<T>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(...) without navigation properties. This satisfies the 'no fields beyond the exhaustive assignment list' AC.

FK delete behaviors: Fleet->everything uses Restrict (safer than Cascade to prevent accidental fleet deletion cascading to all orders); FleetSettings->Fleet uses Cascade (settings lifecycle tied to fleet); OrderEvent->Order uses Cascade (events belong to the order); all User-nullable FKs use SetNull.

Directory.Build.props added at api/ level to pin EF Core package versions to 10.0.12 across all projects, resolving MSB3277 version conflict warnings caused by EFCore.NamingConventions 10.0.1 and Npgsql.EF 10.0.3 pulling in older EF Core versions.
Route entity alias (using RouteEntity = Taxi.Api.Infrastructure.Entities.Route) added in OrderConfiguration.cs due to naming conflict with Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.Route.
